correctness.rationale: Exactly two possible singular spectra follow from contact commutation and reversal. The symbolic construction reproduces both Gram elementary-coefficient differences delta>0, the determinant and the common transfer spectrum, for arbitrary symbolic parameters. A norm-equality argument bounds all Gram roots strictly below one; the cubic difference \(\delta\lambda(1-\lambda)\) then places the serial maximal root strictly below the batched maximal root. Strict Frobenius direction follows from the trace difference. Boundary rates and repeated horizons are excluded. The self-contained script replays exact identities and 100 supplementary finite tests.

value.rationale: The four-agent path is a minimal scheduling network with two commuting disjoint interactions; it permits a complete nontrivial classification over every strength triple in \((0,1)^3\). The discovery is a strict conflict between isotropic and adversarial finite-sweep objectives despite identical transfer spectra, so a spectral-rate schedule recommendation cannot simultaneously optimize both. The weighted all-parameter distinction and singular-root mechanism provide mathematical motivation beyond the already known special equal-weight Frobenius ranking.
